title: checklist re-point after #36047 and #36256/#36461: list type size (13px → two tiers) and drill-through (drawer → centred dialog)
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Kind: stale spec, so re-point the clauses (`checklist-test` §5). In each case the product follows a later ruling, and the clause still holds the earlier one. Found by milestone acceptances #37020 (#35547) and #37022 (#36255) on main `305fe60e`.

- **List type size.** #35547's frame promise and the list clause expect 13px on header, cell and buttons. The page now reads 12px for header labels and 14px for cells and buttons. That is #36047's deliberate two-tier type scale (closed 2026-11-21, on the maintainer's 「同意」): body 14, labels and section headings 12.
  - Re-point the clause to the two tiers, citing #36047.
  - The pin `ui/e2e/list-frame-geometry-35548.spec.ts` reads a transcribed fixture, not the live app. Point it at the live page or note that.
  - `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` also still cites the 32/33 px header and row heights in its e2e description.
- **Drill-through container.** `dashboards.drill-through-range` acceptance[4] and `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` acceptance[1] say the detail list opens in a drawer. It is now a centred dialog with labelled chips (#36256, #36461). Re-point both clauses to the dialog.

Bump each item's revision and add a `history` line.
